_about: Programmed drafts for Salisbury RE Desk, written for this app from Pat Morgan's listing system as Cory runs it. Placeholders in {braces} are filled from the facts the reports computed; every fact in a draft is therefore traceable. Edit the wording freely; keep the placeholders.

weekly_seller_update.subject: Market Update {date} {property}

price_drop_three_options.subject: Three options for {property}
price_drop_three_options.body:
Hi {first},

We are at {days_on_market} days with {showings_total} showings at {list_price}. Here are three honest options:

1. Hold at {list_price} and keep marketing. Best if the next two weeks bring stronger traffic.
2. Step under the next search threshold to {option_threshold}. Buyers searching below that number see the home for the first time.
3. A decisive move to {option_decisive} (about {decisive_pct}% below list). This is the fastest way to a cleaner offer.

My recommendation: {recommendation}

Tell me which one feels right and I will have it live the same day.

deadline_reminder.body: {first}, quick reminder: the {label} for {property} is {due_on} at {due_time} Mountain Time. {meaning} {ask}

touch_gratitude.body: Hi {first}, no agenda today. {reason} Thank you for being part of my year.

touch_business.body: Hi {first}, {reason} Any excuse to say hello. If a question about your home or the market comes up, I am one text away.

complete_file_nag.body: {first}, one item is still open on your file: {item}. Could you send it by {owed_by}? A photo from your phone is fine.
